case_studies.title: SiriusHelper: An LLM Agent-Based Operations Assistant for Big Data Platforms
case_studies.abstract: Big data platforms are widely used in modern enterprises, and an in-production intelligent assistant is increasingly important to help users quickly find actionable guidance and reduce operational burden. case_studies.summary: This research solves the problem of inefficient operations assistance in big data platforms by building an LLM agent-based operations assistant called SiriusHelper, which resulted in improved guidance and reduced operational burden. The assistant helps users quickly find actionable guidance and reduces the need for manual troubleshooting. This can be useful for streamlining big data operations in enterprise environments.

case_studies.summary: This research solves the problem of efficiently deploying Large Language Models on Google's Tensor Processing Units, by building a new attention kernel called Ragged Paged Attention, which resulted in improved performance and flexibility. The new kernel is designed to work efficiently with dynamic and ragged execution patterns. This is relevant for cloud infrastructure managers who use TPUs for LLM workloads.
case_studies.it_breakdown: If you manage LLM workloads on Google's TPUs, consider implementing Ragged Paged Attention to improve performance and reduce costs. case_studies.title: A Systematic Review of MLOps Tools: Tool Adoption, Lifecycle Coverage, and Critical Insights
case_studies.abstract: Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) has become increasingly critical as more organisations move ML models into production. However, the growing landscape of MLOps solutions has introduced complexity for practitioners trying to select appropriate tools. To investigate how and why these tools are adopted in practice, this paper conducts a systematic review of the academic literature focused on MLOps tools. case_studies.summary: This research solves the problem of complexity in selecting Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) tools by conducting a systematic review of academic literature, building a mapping of tools to MLOps lifecycle components, and identifying usage trends and benefits. The result is a clearer understanding of the MLOps tool landscape. This research helps organisations make informed decisions when adopting MLOps tools.
case_studies.it_breakdown: If you manage machine learning model deployment, here is what to do: review your current MLOps tools, map them to the MLOps lifecycle components, and assess their functionality and scope to identify potential gaps or areas for improvement. case_studies.summary: This research solves the problem of leakage threats in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, which are used in large language models. case_studies.summary: This research solves the problem of machine learning model deterioration in semiconductor materials manufacturing by developing optimal retraining strategies using MLOps and uncertainty quantification. The result is a benchmark for identifying the best retraining frequencies and hyperparameter optimization strategies.

case_studies.summary: This research solves the problem of evaluating AI systems in real-world contexts by building a framework called CIRCLE, which provides a lifecycle-based approach to assessing AI's materialized outcomes in deployment, resulting in a more comprehensive understanding of AI's impact on organizations. The CIRCLE framework consists of a six-stage process that bridges the gap between model-centric performance metrics and real-world outcomes.
